sourceRefs.locator: Chapter 5.2, printed pp. 183–186, especially the keelson’s incomplete 104th ring on p. 184, the repair sequence and the summary on pp. 185–186; fig. 55 compares excavated Dublin ship parts.
Printed p. 229, Skuldelev samples. Geographic position of the Peberrenden blocking, 55°48′ N, 12°4′ E, and the narrow channel giving access to Roskilde.

note.de: Nach mehreren Reparaturen wurde Skuldelev 2 wahrscheinlich in den 1070er-Jahren in der zweiten Ausbauphase der Sperre im Roskilde-Fjord versenkt.
note.en: After several repairs Skuldelev 2 was probably sunk in the 1070s, in the second building phase of the barrier in Roskilde Fjord.
